philosophy: Volume beats weight. He wins by never letting your turn begin.

rhythm_profile.signature: decorative off-beat at the END of every move

defense_profile._law: VOLUME 18: defense comes from movement, deception and awkward angles — NOT blocking. blockPreference capped at 0.25 for this archetype.

_note: AUTHORED SOURCE. Volume 14 Combat Genome. 13 components.
identity_statement: The drunk fighter who is secretly the strongest martial artist in the room.

read_engine._note: AUTHORED SOURCE. Brooklyn's signature system and the reason he is the main character.
read_engine._law: Base damage may not rise. The read engine multiplies OUTPUT, never the table. At 0 reads Brooklyn is the weakest fighter in HITM. The governor still audits him at 0 — that is his real balance point.
read_engine._lose_law: Reads are lost, not just gained. He is punished for being read back. This is the only fighter in the cast whose mistakes compound.

tiers.name: Perfect Hunter
tiers.note: 359 x 1.42 = 510, above Rocket's 432 — but Rocket had that from frame one

decay._note: Reads decay if he stops reading. Stand still and the knowledge goes stale.
